versions.changelog:
cargo-diagnostics 1.5.0

- Updated documentation to clarify orchestration run list behavior without `--workflow-uuid` and note necessary usage of `--created-after` with a 30-day window limit.
- Amended instructions for finding runs when no UUID is available.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Minor edits to documentation for clarity and completeness.

cargo-diagnostics 1.4.0

- Adds explicit documentation of execution charge (0.01 credits per node execution) in cost attribution for play credit optimization.
- Updates references/play-optimize-credits.md to reflect the above and clarify how execution charge is handled.
- Updates version to 1.4.0 in skill metadata.
- Removes the legacy skill-card.md file.

cargo-diagnostics v1.3.0

- Adds support for drawing and interpreting execution graphs, clarifying run routing and skipped steps.
- Expands triggers to cover branch logic issues ("it went down the wrong path", "this step never ran", "show me what the run did").
- Documents the use of the node diagram command as core evidence, especially for debugging run routing and branch errors.
- Removes the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Updates documentation and reference surfaces to reflect new diagnostic capabilities.

cargo-diagnostics 1.2.0

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and references/run-trace.md.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- Updated skill-metadata.json for version and metadata alignment.

cargo-diagnostics 1.1.0

- Clarified and expanded the skill description to clearly list triggers and when to use or not use this skill.
- Added a new "Bootstrap" section with step-by-step instructions for installing and signing in to the Cargo CLI.
- Expanded guidance on finding a run UUID when only a symptom is present, emphasizing alternate query methods.
- Updated instructions for presenting findings, including piloting fixes for 10–20 records before any full re-run.
- Removed redundant documentation file (skill-card.md) for conciseness.

- Updated to version 1.0.2.
- Added skill-metadata.json file.
- Removed skill-card.md file.
- Improved login instructions in prerequisites and compatibility text (now includes `cargo-ai login --email` flow).
- No changes to core logic or runbooks.

- Add section clarifying boundaries with cargo-analytics, explaining this skill focuses on diagnosis, not measurement/export.
- No functional changes to commands or behavior.
- Version bump to 1.0.1.

Initial release of cargo-diagnostics 1.0.0

- Diagnose and explain workflow behavior using forensic runbooks for Cargo-powered workflows.
- Supports tracing single runs, sweeping batches for errors, and profiling credit (cost) attribution.
- Guides users to pull and interpret raw orchestration and billing surfaces.
- Provides references for tracing runs, sweeping batches for errors, and optimizing play credits.
- Requires @cargo-ai/cli (npm) and a Cargo account for full functionality.
